entry.verified: SHA512SUMS gpg-verified (Mozilla release key 14F2 6682 D091 6CDD 81E3 7B6D 61B7 B526 D98F 0353), installer SHA512 matches; Authenticode: Mozilla Corporation, chain ok (osslsigncode); driver: Authenticode signer Mozilla Corporation, digest ok, chain ends at DigiCert Assured ID Root CA which the local store lacks
entry.notes: Silent /S install, not default browser. distribution\policies.json {DisableAppUpdate:true} added so the 115 ESR line (still updating) cannot move the version under the manifest/driver. geckodriver >=0.33 checks the Host header: forward with the same local port as the driver port (ssh -L P:127.0.0.1:P) or it answers 'Invalid Host header'. geckodriver 0.35.0 exits 0xC0000139 on Win7 and 0.36.0 crashes (0xC0000005), so 0.34.0 (min Firefox 115) is used here.
